sourceName: NHANES 2017-2018 public-use Linked Mortality File pilot
policyPurpose: Define a synthetic publication-review gate for future NHANES public-use LMF weighted-domain outputs, covering effective sample size, confidence interval width class, degrees of freedom and relative standard error before any real public output can be considered.

currentDecision.reason: The policy validates publication-review shape only. It does not compute effective sample sizes, real confidence intervals, rates, counts, calibration or individual predictions.

validatorContract.currentBoundary: synthetic publication criteria validation only; no real NHANES weighted rates, design-based confidence intervals, denominator counts, weighted sums, mortality cells, calibration or individual output are present

sourceAnchors.observedFact: NHANES reliability guidance lists sample size, effective sample size, design effect, confidence interval width, degrees of freedom and relative standard error as reliability dimensions.
sourceAnchors.modelConsequence: Future public weighted-domain output must carry a reliability-review state before it can be considered for publication.

sourceAnchors.observedFact: NCHS data presentation standards for proportions use minimum denominator sample size, confidence interval width and degrees-of-freedom review, with suppression or statistical review when criteria fail.
sourceAnchors.modelConsequence: This policy represents CI-width, effective-sample and degrees-of-freedom checks as synthetic classes until real output exists.

sourceAnchors.observedFact: NCHS data presentation standards for rates and counts apply sample-size and confidence-interval criteria to support reliable presentation.
sourceAnchors.modelConsequence: Future mortality-rate-like outputs need a statistic-specific publication review rather than a raw output dump.

prohibitedActions: Do not treat synthetic publication criteria validation as a real NCHS publication clearance.
Do not publish real weighted domain rates, intervals, denominator counts or death counts from this policy alone.
Do not treat effective sample size or confidence interval classes as calibration, causal evidence, clinical evidence or individual prediction evidence.
Do not output individual death dates, personal medical advice or personal longevity rankings.
nextWork: Run the synthetic publication criteria validator and publish only the generated validator report.

When real weighted-domain output exists, replace synthetic classes with statistic-specific effective sample size, confidence interval, RSE and degrees-of-freedom calculations under a separate review gate.
Keep this publication criteria gate separate from disclosure review, real weighted-domain output implementation, calibration and external validation.
